subject: GI ideas: cross-exam verify gate and W2.b drill
body:
Sharing 3 ideas:

1. Add cross-exam uniqueness gate to QA: run tests/cross-exam-verify.js on data changes to catch answer collisions before release.

2. W2.b micro-drill: short 5-question set focused on intercepts to reinforce Kai's only gap.

3. Dashboard readiness checklist: show recommended order and last score, easy for Kai to follow.

If you want, I can help define acceptance criteria for the gate.
